item.title: New TN bill aimed to stop live streaming evictions
item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn. — A new bill sponsored by Tenn. Rep. Antonio Parkinson could stop people from live streaming evictions without consent. item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn. — A Memphis woman celebrated her 92nd birthday with her long-time work family at the Gould's Salon in Germantown.
